dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent, high-contrast pale edges create sharp boundaries along the outer webs of the folded primary and secondary feathers against dark centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A visible transition where the uniform, fine-textured brown of the crown meets the high-contrast scalloped pattern of the mantle, though a sharp linear boundary is absent.
